free_text: The 64-year-old male presents with an elevated PSA of 5.3 ng/mL and a prior biopsy showing Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2). MRI revealed a focal hypointense lesion in the peripheral zone with restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was noted. Given the findings, the management assessment is active surveillance, balancing the potential benefit of treatment against patient preferences and individual treatment benefit.
